_comment: St. Patrick's Day collection. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed st-patrick-shamrock` (lines may be shared with other collections since #24), Luvdisc swapped in from St. Patrick's Day for Marshadow, then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_patrick.py.

readme.title: St. Patrick's Day
readme.summary: Pokemon with the luck of the Irish.
looks: each line wears one look: shamrocks on emerald green (Shaymin, Jigglypuff, Popplio); a leprechaun's coat, belt and gold buckle (Impidimp, Croagunk, Marshadow); a pot of gold (Heatran, Pawniard, Darumaka); a rainbow over clouds (Lugia, Azelf, Shinx); gold Celtic knotwork (Stantler, Terrakion, Tirtouga); an Irish tartan (Sawk, Tepig, Jangmo-o)
lucky sparkles and gold glints twinkle in the dark; the eyes keep their own colours
shiny: the green turned to gold
